originalTitle: Dow Jones Futures: S&P 500 Hits High On Workday, Sandisk, Oil Prices; Applied Materials Earnings Late
summary: The S&P 500 hit a new high amid lower oil prices. Workday and Sandisk lifted software and memory plays. Applied Materials fell late on earnings.

chineseTitle: 道琼斯期货：标准普尔 500 指数在工作日触及高位，Sandisk、油价；应用材料公司公布业绩较晚
chineseSummary: 在油价下跌的背景下，标准普尔 500 指数创下新高。 Workday 和 Sandisk 提升了软件和内存的性能。应用材料公司的财报尾盘下跌。
